aboutGame.title: What is Mycopunk?
paragraphs: Mycopunk is a mission-based sci-fi looter shooter from Pigeons at Play and Devolver Digital. Play solo or join a four-player online crew of robots fighting fungal enemies across planet-side missions. Enemies can even use parts dropped by other enemies, so combat keeps changing as you fight.

Each mission grants mods for grid-based upgrades to your robot and weapons. Mix and stack the pieces that fit to experiment with different combat roles, then return to the orbital dropship between missions. Our guides cover the first missions, weapon choices, upgrade grids, and co-op play.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to common Mycopunk questions about missions, upgrades, and co-op.

items.question: What is Mycopunk?
items.answer: Mycopunk is a mission-based sci-fi looter shooter about a crew of robots fighting fungal enemies. You can play solo or in four-player online co-op and customize robots and weapons through upgrade grids.

items.question: Can I play Mycopunk alone?
items.answer: Yes. Steam lists single-player alongside four-player online co-op.

items.question: How do I get upgrades in Mycopunk?
items.answer: Missions grant mods that you can fit into upgrade grids for your robot and weapons. Mix and stack the mods that fit your available grid space.

items.question: How many players can join a Mycopunk crew?
items.answer: Mycopunk supports up to four players in online co-op. You can take on planet-side missions together and regroup aboard the orbital dropship between missions.

items.question: Who developed Mycopunk and where can I play it?
items.answer: Pigeons at Play developed Mycopunk, Devolver Digital published it, and the Steam listing supports Windows PC.
